Contact.description: The contact detail. System fields names are prefixed with underscore.

_androidAppVersion.description: The version of the mobile app in Android (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_androidLastActivityDate.description: The date of the last activity of the contact in the mobile app in Android, in ISO8601 format (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_androidOsVersion.description: The version of the Android operating system (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_androidSdkVersion.description: The version of the Connectif SDK used in the mobile app in Android (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_averagePurchasesAmount.description: Average amount of the registered contact purchases.

_birthdate.description: Birthdate of the contact in ISO8601 format.

_churnRate.description: The opposite of p-alive. The probability that the customer has churned on us. The value is expressed as percentage from 0 to 100. If the value is null it means the contact is not a buyer or the CLV metrics are not enabled in your account. More info https://support.connectif.ai/hc/es/articles/6042260554012.

_clv.description: Customer Lifetime Value of the contact for the next 12 months. If the value is null it means the contact is not a buyer or the CLV metrics are not enabled in your account. More info https://support.connectif.ai/hc/es/articles/6042260554012.

_createdAt.description: The date of creation of the contact in ISO8601 format.

_email.description: The email that identifies the contact.

_emailBouncedReason.description: Description of the reason why the last bounced email sent to the contact was bounced.
_emailBouncedReason.example: 452 4.2.2 The email account that you tried to reach is over quota.

_emailLastBouncedDate.description: The date of the last time an email sent to the contact was hard-bounced in ISO8601 format.

_emailLastSoftBounceDate.description: The date of the last time an email sent to the contact was soft-bounced in ISO8601 format.

_emailLastSubscribedDate.description: The date of the last time the contact subscribed from email newsletter in ISO8601 format.

_emailLastSubscribedIp.description: The IP address from which the contact subscribed to the email newsletter for the last time.

_emailLastSubscribedOrigin.description: Origin of the last time the contact subscribed to email newsletter.

_emailLastTrackingConsentDeniedDate.description: The date when the contact last denied email tracking consent, in ISO8601 format (only if email tracking consent is enabled).

_emailLastTrackingConsentGrantedDate.description: The date when the contact last granted email tracking consent, in ISO8601 format (only if email tracking consent is enabled).

_emailLastUnsubscribedDate.description: The date of the last time the contact unsubscribed from email newsletter in ISO8601 format.

_emailLastUnsubscribedIp.description: The IP address from which the contact unsubscribed from the email newsletter for the last time.

_emailLastUnsubscribedOrigin.description: Origin of the last time the contact unsubscribed from email newsletter.

_emailSoftBounces.description: How many soft bounces have happened when sending emails to the contact.

_emailStatus.description: Status of the email address of the contact: active (email address is valid and can receive emails), bounced, paused or banned.

_emailTrackingConsent.description: Email tracking consent: granted, denied or not-set (only if email tracking consent is enabled).

_expectedPurchases.description: It represents how many purchases we can expect to see up to the next 12 months from this contact. If the value is null it means the contact is not a buyer or the CLV metrics are not enabled in your account. More info https://support.connectif.ai/hc/es/articles/6042260554012.

_externalId.description: The external id of the contact.

_firstPurchaseDate.description: The date of the first time a purchase of the contact was registered in ISO8601 format.

_hasAndroidMobilePushPermission.description: Whether the contact has Android mobile push permission (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_hasIosMobilePushPermission.description: Whether the contact has iOS mobile push permission (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_hasMobilePushPermission.description: Whether the contact has mobile push permission in Android or iOS (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_hasPushSubscriptions.description: Whether the contact has at least 1 push subscription or not.

_iosAppVersion.description: The version of the mobile app in iOS (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_iosLastActivityDate.description: The date of the last activity of the contact in the mobile app in iOS, in ISO8601 format (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_iosOsVersion.description: The version of the iOS operating system (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_iosSdkVersion.description: The version of the Connectif SDK used in the mobile app in iOS (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

_isAnonymous.description: Whether the contact has an email address or not.

_lastPurchaseDate.description: The date of the last time a purchase of the contact was registered in ISO8601 format.

_mobilePhone.description: The phone number of the contact in international format.

_mobilePhoneStatus.description: Status of the phone number of the contact: active (phone number is valid and can receive SMS), bounced or paused.

_newsletterSubscriptionStatus.description: Status of subscription of the contact to the email newsletter: subscribed, unsubscribed or none (not specified yet).

_pAlive.description: The probability of the customer being alive. By alive we understand that the customer could buy from us again. The value is expressed as percentage from 0 to 100. If the value is null it means the contact is not a buyer or the CLV metrics are not enabled in your account. More info https://support.connectif.ai/hc/es/articles/6042260554012.

_smsSubscriptionStatus.description: Status of subscription of the contact to the SMS newsletter: subscribed, unsubscribed or none (not specified yet).

_totalPurchases.description: How many purchases of the contact have been registered.

_totalPurchasesAmount.description: Total amount of the registered contact purchases.

_updatedAt.description: The date of last update of the contact in ISO8601 format.

_usesMobileApp.description: Whether the contact uses the mobile app or not (only if mobile app integration is enabled).

id.description: The tracker id of the contact.

custom.description: Indicates if the field is custom. Custom fields are created by the member of the store.

defaultCountryCode.description: Indicates if the default country code of the phone field. Only available when the field type is "phone".

defaultValue.description: The default value of the field. Default value must be set always when the field is required.

maxDate.description: Indicates if the max valid date of a date field. Only available when the field type is "date".

maxLength.description: Indicates if the max length of the text field. Only available when the field type is "text".

maxValue.description: Indicates if the max valid value of a field. Only available when the field type is "integer" or "decimal".

minDate.description: Indicates if the min valid date of a date field. Only available when the field type is "date".

minValue.description: Indicates if the min valid value of a field. Only available when the field type is "integer" or "decimal".

options.description: Indicates the allowed options of a field. Only available when the field type is "checkbox" or "radio".

readOnly.description: Indicates if the field is read only. If true the field value cannot be modified.

required.description: Indicates if the field is required. When a field is required it means that a contact must have always a value for that field. A required field must always have a default value set.

status.description: The processing status of the field

ContactFieldCreate.description: The contact field creation request body

defaultCountryCode.description: The default country code of the phone field. Required when the field type is "phone". Not allowed for other field types. Must be a valid phone country code (e.g. "1", "34", "44").

defaultValue.description: The default value of the field. Required when the field is required, and cannot be an empty string for required text fields. Not allowed for email and phone fields. The accepted type depends on the field type: string for text and radio, number for integer and decimal (must be an integer for integer fields), boolean for boolean, ISO 8601 date string for date, and an array of unique strings for checkbox. For radio fields, the value must match one of the provided option ids. For checkbox fields, all items must match valid option ids.

id.description: The id of the field. Must start with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores, and brackets. The value "id" is reserved. Maximum length is 150 characters.

maxDate.description: The maximum valid date of a date field. Only allowed when the field type is "date". Must be a UTC date in ISO 8601 format. Must be greater than or equal to minDate when both are provided. Not allowed for other field types.

maxLength.description: The max length of the text field value. Only allowed when the field type is "text". Must be an integer between 1 and 5000. Not allowed for other field types.

maxValue.description: The maximum valid value of the field. Only allowed when the field type is "integer" or "decimal". Must be an integer for integer fields. Must be greater than or equal to minValue when both are provided. Not allowed for other field types.

minDate.description: The minimum valid date of a date field. Only allowed when the field type is "date". Must be a UTC date in ISO 8601 format. Must be less than or equal to maxDate when both are provided. Not allowed for other field types.

minValue.description: The minimum valid value of the field. Only allowed when the field type is "integer" or "decimal". Must be an integer for integer fields. Must be less than or equal to maxValue when both are provided. Not allowed for other field types.

name.description: The name of the field. Maximum length is 200 characters.

options.description: The allowed options of the field. Required when the field type is "checkbox" or "radio". Must contain at least 1 and at most 120 options. Each option id must be unique and have a maximum length of 50 characters. Each option label has a maximum length of 320 characters. Not allowed for other field types.

required.description: Indicates if the field is required. When a field is required, a contact must always have a value for that field and a default value must be provided. Must be true for boolean and checkbox fields. Must be false for email and phone fields.
